t: This is Earls Court Road, a street in Earls Court in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Matilda Costello died here in 1874. She was born in 1828, which would make her about forty-five or forty-six. The material I have gives no occupation or story for her, and I don't want to invent one. All that's recorded is that she lived her last days on this road, back in the Victorian era, when Earls Court was a very different place.
